content_sections.heading: About Rajarshi Shahu Mahavidyalaya
content_sections.text: Rajarshi Shahu Mahavidyalaya is a college in Latur, Maharashtra, run by Shiv Chhatrapati Shikshan Sanstha, Latur. The notice describes it as an Empowered Autonomous Institution, accredited by NAAC A+ Grade (4th Cycle) with 3.49 CGPA, and affiliated to Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded. The posts advertised are grant-in-aid posts.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 10 posts of Assistant Professor in eight subjects: 1+1+2+1+1+2+1+1 = 10. The notice prints the reservation once, against the whole set of posts, and not subject by subject. For disability, the notice shows Group-A (Blindness / Low Vision): 1 post. The posts are advertised with permission as per NOC No. JDHE/Nanded/NOC/2026/00011 dated 12.08.2026.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints no experience requirement. Besides the Master's degree, the notice requires one of the following: The candidate has cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar UGC-accredited test such as SET. The candidate is or has been awarded a Ph.D. in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments, and is exempted from NET/SET. OR the Ph.D. was obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by QS, Times Higher Education (THE) or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU), Shanghai. Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme before 11 July 2009 are governed by the Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the awarding institution and are exempted from NET/SET, provided all of these conditions are met: Fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned. NET/SET is also not required for Master's programmes in disciplines for which NET/SET is not conducted; in such disciplines a Ph.D. remains the minimum eligibility for Assistant Professor. A relaxation of 5% is allowed at the Bachelor's and Master's level for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, OBC (Non-creamy Layer) and differently-abled candidates, for eligibility and assessing good academic record. It is based only on qualifying marks, without any grace mark procedure. A relaxation of 5% (from 55% to 50%) is given to Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's degree before 19 September 1991. A relevant grade regarded as equivalent to 55% at the Master's level, where a recognised university follows a grading system, is also valid. The general note 06 states: relaxation of 5% marks at P.G. level for SC/ST candidates only. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Minimum qualification as per UGC Regulations (2018) and Government of Maharashtra G.R.s dated 08 March 2019, 10/05/2019, 05/03/2024, 31/08/2026 and 06/11/2026. A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice gives the salary and allowances as the pay scale as per UGC, State Govt. and S.R.T.M. University, Nanded rules from time to time. No amount or pay level is printed. The notice says the posts are grant-in-aid posts. No T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the interview. The vacancies of Assistant Professors will be filled subject to the decision in writ petition No.12051/2015 pending in the Hon'ble High Court of Judicature of Bombay, Bench at Aurangabad. According to Govt. rules, 30% and 4% of seats will be reserved for women and disabled persons respectively.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Rajarshi Shahu Mahavidyalaya Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Take the prescribed application form from the University website www.srtmun.ac.in or the College website www.shahucollegelatur.org.in . Attach all attested Xerox copies of certificates and other relevant documents to the application form. Send the application by registered post or deliver it in person to: Principal, Rajarshi Shahu Mahavidyalaya, Kaku Sheth Ukka Marg, Chandra Nagar, Latur - 413512 (Maharashtra). The notice also gives the college email [email protected] . Candidates of the reserved category must also submit one copy of the application to the Assistant Registrar, Special Cell, Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded, by registered post only. Candidates already in service must submit their applications through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice states that the academic score specified in Appendix II (Table 3A for Universities, Table 3B for Colleges) is considered only for short-listing candidates for interview. The selections are based only on performance in the interview. The notice prints no interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form. All attested Xerox copies of certificates and other relevant documents. For reserved category candidates: one more copy of the application for the Assistant Registrar, Special Cell, SRTMU Nanded.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor posts are vacant at Rajarshi Shahu Mahavidyalaya, Latur?
faq.answer: There are 10 grant-in-aid Assistant Professor posts: English 1, Sanskrit 1, Commerce 2, Chemistry 1, Electronics 1, Microbiology 2, Analytical Chemistry 1 and Fisheries Science 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the college within 15 days from the date the advertisement is published online on www.shahucollegelatur.org.in. The notice prints no publication date; counted from 19 November 2026 this is about 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject, plus NET/SET or a Ph.D. awarded under UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016, as the notice describes.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Send the completed prescribed form with attested copies of certificates by registered post or in person to the Principal, Rajarshi Shahu Mahavidyalaya, Kaku Sheth Ukka Marg, Chandra Nagar, Latur - 413512 (Maharashtra). The notice also gives the email [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. Where is the application form available?
faq.answer: The prescribed application form is on the University website www.srtmun.ac.in and the College website www.shahucollegelatur.org.in.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Candidates are short-listed for interview on the academic score in Appendix II (Table 3B for Colleges). Selection is based only on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale is as per UGC, State Govt. and S.R.T.M. University, Nanded rules from time to time. The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A./D.A. will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What should reserved category candidates do?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates must submit one copy of their application to the Assistant Registrar, Special Cell, Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded, by registered post only.

faq.question: Q10. How should candidates already in service apply?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates who are already in service should submit their applications through proper channel.
